note: Every runtime asset used by NIGHT OF THE RISEN is downloaded from the web by tools/fetch-assets.mjs. Sources are permissively licensed (three.js examples asset pool: MIT / CC0 / CC-BY as noted per entry).

assets.use: Daylight image-based lighting. An overcast urban street rather than open sky: the arena is a walled precinct, so its ambient should come off brick and asphalt.
Grime overlay / detail breakup on roads and walls
Roughness breakup for metal and asphalt
Blood droplets, smoke puffs, light glow
Low ambient drone bed under procedural audio

assets.license: Provenance unclear — NOT cleared for release. Taken from iErcann/enari-engine (the repository is MIT, but this model is not among the Sketchfab attributions in its README, and its material names "t_phoenix" and "v_hands" are Counter-Strike / Half-Life viewmodel conventions, so it is most likely derived from those assets). Included at the project owner's explicit request for a non-commercial test build. Replace before shipping.
assets.use: First-person rifle viewmodel: 14,091 triangles, rigged arms with gloved hands and a full finger chain, and an authored hold animation. Used for the AKM slot, and its hands rig is reused to hold the procedurally built weapons.

assets.license: CC0 1.0 Universal — weapon bodies by Quaternius (Ultimate Guns Pack, quaternius.com); reload mechanism geometry, sockets and GLB composition by Operation Steel Tide (MIT), which documents the provenance in docs/CONTENT_PROVENANCE.md. Reached through that repository because quaternius.com and poly.pizza are unreachable from the build sandbox.
assets.use: Pistol viewmodel. Ships named ChargingHandle and Magazine parts plus grip sockets, so the slide and magazine animate through the same rig as the built weapons.

assets.license: CC0 1.0 Universal — Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), scanned and modelled by their asset team. Reached through EMMA019/KAGRA, which mirrors the glTF and its buffer, because polyhaven.com and cdn.polyhaven.com are unreachable from the build sandbox. That mirror carries geometry and UVs but no texture images, so these are re-finished with the game's own materials on load.
